sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Surplus Goods is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. I've decided to get involved with military electronics, it's quite a promising business, and I've got interested people for that. And the army, as you know, has the most secure communication: digital encryptions, GPS, GLONASS and all kinds of other things. So anyway, I've got info about some device on Reserve, usually seen in workshops, I think it's used in machinery, it's some kind of control and navigation block. I want you to find this block and bring it to me. Would be interesting to see what it has inside of it. I'll reward you of course."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Obtain the MBT Integrated Navigation System on Reserve
- Hand over the navigation system to Mechanic

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,500 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 40,000 Roubles
  - 42,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 46,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Ultraviolet lamp
- 2× Energy-saving lamp
"So that's how it looks! Great. Thank you, I'll study it more thoroughly later. Here's your reward, as promised."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| RB-ST key | 1 | Required | N/A | Unlocks room RB-ST where the MBT Integrated Navigation System is located. |
| MBT Integrated Navigation System | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |

In this quest you need to pick up and extract with an MBT Integrated Navigation System. It can be found inside a locked room in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. A RB-ST key is required to open the door.

The item can be found inside a wooden crate in the back left of the room.
